# Establishment log — bardo-thodol-004 (pp. 36–45), 2026-11-21

Read by three readers (strongest model; pp. 35 tail–38, 39–41, 42–45.1), each checking the stored dzogchengonpa.org
witness line by line against crops of the page images (×3, ×5–×10 on doubt). Five print lines on every page; the
witness's line breaks match the print on all 46 lines read. The part begins with དེ་ནས་བཅོམ་ལྡན་ at the end of p. 35 l. 5
(left over from bardo-thodol-003, checked on n36) and ends at …སངས་རྒྱས་པར་འགྱུར་རོ༔ on p. 45 l. 1: p. 44 ends mid-word
(དབྱེར|མེད), and the sentence "if you recognise it … you become a buddha" closes on p. 45; the rest of 45.1
(རང་གི་རིག་པའི་རང་མདངས་སུ་མ་ཤེས་ན་ནི༔ …རིན་ཆེན་) begins bardo-thodol-005.
Image overruled the witness: 21 (A) + 12 (B) + 17 (C) = 50. [?]: 3 (39.3 དུད, 39.4 དུ, 41.4 འཕྲང), plus 44.3 ལ (tsheg unseen).

## Decisions taken when assembling (for the drafter)
- `# fix:` lines: one contraction written out, ནམཁའི (43.2); one tsheg dropped mid-line, དེ་ལམ་འཇིགས → དེ་ལ་མ་འཇིགས (39.5;
  the same phrase is written ལ་མ at 44.3); tshegs missing at nine line joins (དགག་པའི|བར, སངས|རྒྱས, བུ་མ|ཡེངས, ཆེའི|གདན,
  མེ་ཏྲི|གཉིས, བར་དོའི|འཕྲང, གསལ|ལ, དག་པའི|འོད, དབྱེར|མེད across the leaf ornament). Every fix was checked to apply once.
- Treated as clear misprints (README rule 5b; each unit's note must name the print's reading):
  - 37.4–5 ཞི་སྡང → ཞེ་སྡང ("anger", beside སྡིག་སྒྲིབ; the gi-gu is clear on the image; the other recension ཞེ་སྡང; the
    print has ཞེ་སྡང everywhere else on these pages).
  - 37.5 འོད་དང་ཟེར་ལ་བཀྲག་ནས → སྐྲག་ནས ("afraid of the lights and rays"; the other recension སྐྲག). The same
    སྐྲག/བཀྲག swap as at 34.4, 34.5, 35.3 in 003.
  - 42.4 འབྱུང་བས་ཐམས་ཅད → འབྱུང་བ་ས་ཐམས་ཅད ("the element earth, all wholly pure"; the parallel for day two at 38.2 is
    འབྱུང་བ་ཆུ་ཐམས་ཅད; the other recension འབྱུང་བ་ས). Tsheg missing, as མགྲོལ in 003.
- Kept as printed, with a note (recurring, so perhaps the carver's habit, or more than one correction possible):
  - མཚེར for འཚེར "glittering": 39.1, 41.2, 43.4, 44.3 (the print has འཚེར at 39.5; the other recension འཚེར throughout).
    Four times on these pages; translate as འཚེར and say so once in a note.
  - 39.4, 40.3 འོད་དུ་ཁ beside 39.3 འོད་དུད[?]་ཁ "smoke-coloured" (the other recension དུད་ཀ). Translate "smoky" and note it.
  - 40.3 བསུ་བ་ལ་ཡོངས་པ་ཡིན་ནོ "has come to meet": ཡོངས "all" makes no sense; the print's same phrase at 36.1 is
    འོངས་པ, the other recension འོང་བ. Not correctable one way (ཡོང / འོངས); note.
  - 39.2 ཡབ་ཡུམ་ཀྱི (for གྱི), 43.3 སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱིས་སྐུ (for ཀྱི), 36.5 བདག་གིས་ལད་མོ (other recension གི), 40.4
    སྡིག་སྒྲིབ་ཀྱི (other recension ཀྱིས), 40.5 མ་འབྱུང་གིས (other recension མི་འབྱུང་གི), 44.4 བཞོགས་ཤིག ("rest"; the other
    recension ཞོག་ཅིག): note only.
- Senses where the other recension differs (details in the readers' logs): 40.2–3 the print has the narrow passage (འཕྲང)
  of the bardo where the other has the terrors (འཇིགས་སྐྲག); 44.1–2 the print's light of humans is blue (སྔོན་པོ), the
  other's bluish-yellow (སྔོན་སེར); the print has no ཡབ་ཡུམ at 37.3 and no "flees" at 37.5, and adds ཐམས་ཅད at 38.2.
- The print's own spellings kept: འཁྱམས་བའི, སྙམ་བའི, མངོན་བར, ཤེས་བར, དག་བ, མཐིང་ཁ, བསྐྱོར beside སྐྱོར, གཤིབས་མར/གཤིབ་མར,
  སྲན་མི་བཟོད, ཀློང/ཀླུང, མཱ་ལྱམ, ལཱ་སྱ་མ, སྣང་མཛད (the mark over ཛ read as its own hook, as in 003).
- Filler dots at line ends and inside lines are left out of the text, as in 002–003.

None.

Close calls, not marked [?]:
- 36.3 དགག་པའི: no tsheg can be seen between ག and པ, because the foot of ག runs into it. The witness's tsheg is kept (tsheg policy as in read2_B/read_C).
- 38.4 མེ་ཏྲི: the two syllables are set tight together, and a tsheg between them can't be seen. The witness's tsheg is kept.
- 36.5 (line end) འཁོར་བར་: filler dots follow, and the tsheg can't be told apart from the first dot. The witness's tsheg is kept. Fillers are left out.
- The hook over ཛ in མཛད (36.1 twice, 36.4, 37.1, 37.3) is a plain rising hook on top of the letter. I read it as the letter's own shape, as read_C did. If the editor reads it as a na-ro, all five places would become མཛོད. The other recension has མཛད throughout.

## Witness readings checked and confirmed, though odd

36.1 ཡབ་ཡུམ་གྱི་ཁྱོད (the other recension has the same). 36.5 བདག་གིས་ལད་མོ (གིས is clear). 37.1 འཁྱམས་བའི and 37.1 གསལ་བའི (closed བ, compared at ×8 with the open པ in པར in the same line). 37.2 ཡིས. 37.3 ས་རུ (the ུ hook is under ར). 37.4 སྐུ་རུ, ངོ་སྤྲད, ཞི་ (see misprints). 37.5 བཀྲག་ནས (prefix བ and ཀྲ are certain at ×10; see misprints). 37.5 ཞག་གཉིས་པ་རྡོ (no ལ). 38.1 དང་༔ (a separate tsheg dot between ང and ༔ on the pixel map). 38.3 རྩེ་ལྔ་པ. 38.5 ལཱ་སྱ་མ (the a-chung under ལ is clear, and there is no e-stroke over སྱ). 38.5 ཀླུང་ནས (ང with its diagonal, ×9).

All five are tshegs missing at a line join (36.3→36.4, 37.2→37.3, 38.1→38.2, 38.3→38.4, 38.4→38.5). There are no line-end or mid-line contractions on these pages.

## Suspected misprints (kept as printed)

1. 37.5 འོད་དང་ཟེར་ལ་བཀྲག་ནས → སྐྲག་ནས. Certainty is high. The sense is "afraid of the lights and rays". The other recension has འོད་དང་ཟེར་ལ་སྐྲག་ནས. This is the same སྐྲག/བཀྲག swap that read_C found at 34.5/35.3. Proposed: `# fix: ཟེར་ལ་བཀྲག་ནས => ཟེར་ལ་སྐྲག་ནས`.
2. 37.4→37.5 ཞི་སྡང → ཞེ་སྡང ("anger", one of the kleśas, next to sdig sgrib). Certainty is high. The gi-gu is clear on the image, and the other recension has ཞེ་སྡང. Proposed: `# fix: ཀྱང་ཞི་ => ཀྱང་ཞེ་` (37.4 line end).
3. 36.5 བདག་གིས་ལད་མོ་གྱིས: the other recension has བདག་གི་ལད་མོ ("imitating me", genitive). The instrumental is awkward but readable. Kept, note only.
4. 38.5 ལཱ་སྱ་མ: the other recension has ལཱ་སྱེ་མ (Lāsyā). This is the print's spelling of a Sanskrit name. Kept, note only.

Not misprints, the print's own habits: བ for པ after open syllables (37.1 འཁྱམས་བའི, གསལ་བའི); མཐིང་ཁ for མཐིང་ག (36.4, 38.3); སྤྲད for སྤྲོད (37.4, 38.1).

## Where the other recension differs in sense (print followed)

- 36.1: print ལ་འོངས་པ་ཡིན་ནོ; other recension ལ་འོང་བ་ཡིན་ནོ. The sense is the same.
- 36.5: print བདག་གིས; other recension བདག་གི (see misprints 3).
- 37.3: print སྨོན་ལམ་དེ་སྐད་དུ་བཏབ་པས ("made the prayer in these words"); other recension སྨོན་ལམ་བཏབ་པས. Print རྣམ་པར་སྣང་མཛད་ཀྱི་ཐུགས་ཀར; other recension …ཡབ་ཡུམ་གྱི་ཐུགས་ཀར. The print has no "father-mother", as at 35.5.
- 37.4: print ཞིང་ཁམས་སུ, སྐུ་རུ; other recension ཞིང་དུ, སྐུར. The sense is the same.
- 37.5: print …ཀྱི་རྐྱེན་གྱིས ("by the condition of"); other recension …ཀྱི་སྐྱོན་གྱིས ("by the fault of"). Print …བཀྲག་ནས་སྨོན་ལམ་བཏབ་ན་ཡང་འཁྲུལ་ན ("even if, being [afraid], one makes the prayer and still errs"); other recension …སྐྲག་ནས་བྲོས་ཏེ༔ སྨོན་ལམ་བཏབ་ཀྱང་ཡང་འཁྲུལ་ན. The print does not have "flees".
- 37.5: print ཞག་གཉིས་པ་རྡོ་རྗེ…; other recension ཞག་གཉིས་པ་ལ་རྡོ་རྗེ…. The print has no ལ. The sense is the same.
- 38.1: print ལས་ངན་གཉིས་བསུ་བ་ལ་འོང ("the two… come to meet"); other recension ལས་ངན་གཉིས་ཀྱིས་བསུ་བ་ལ་འོང. The print has no instrumental.

## Suspected misprints (kept as printed)

1. 39.1 and 41.2 ལ་མཚེར་བ → ལ་འཚེར་བ ("glittering"). Certainty is moderate to high. མཚེར is not a word. The print itself writes དཀར་ལ་འཚེར་བ at 39.5, and the other recension has འཚེར at both places. Because it happens twice it could be the carver's habit. Proposed: `# fix: ལ་མཚེར => ལ་འཚེར` (both places). This is the drafter's choice.
2. 39.4 and 40.3 འོད་དུ་ཁ → འོད་དུད་ཁ ("the dull smoke-coloured light of hell"). Certainty is moderate to high. 39.3 has the full དུད (read with [?] for its final), and the other recension has དུད་ཀ throughout. དུ་ཁ makes no sense. Proposed: `# fix: འོད་དུ་ཁ => འོད་དུད་ཁ` (two places).
3. 40.3 བསུ་བ་ལ་ཡོངས་པ་ཡིན་ནོ → ཡོང་པ ("has come to meet you"). Certainty is high for the stem: ཡོངས ("all") makes no sense, and the other recension has བསུ་བ་འོང་བ. Proposed: `# fix: ལ་ཡོངས་པ => ལ་ཡོང་པ`. The print's པ/བ is left alone.
4. 39.2 ཡབ་ཡུམ་ཀྱི → གྱི (the genitive after མ). Certainty is moderate. The letter is certainly ཀ, and the other recension has གྱི. Possible `# fix: ཡུམ་ཀྱི་ཐུགས => ཡུམ་གྱི་ཐུགས`. This is the drafter's choice.
5. 40.5 ཐར་པའི་དུས་མ་འབྱུང་གིས༔ ("the time of liberation will not come"). The future needs མི, and the other recension has མི་འབྱུང་གི. Certainty is moderate. It can't be corrected in only one way: མ→མི, and also གིས→གི. Note only.
6. 40.4 སྡིག་སྒྲིབ་ཀྱི་བསུ་བའི་ལམ: the other recension has ཀྱིས་བསུ་མའི. The genitive reads "the welcoming path of the obscurations", which is acceptable. Note only.

Not misprints, the print's own spelling: 40.2 སྙམ་བའི; 39.3 གཤིབས་མར (other recension གཤིབ); 40.5 སྲན (other recension བསྲན); 41.4 བསྐྱོར (other recension སྐྱོར); 41.5 བཏབ་པས། with a shad.

### read_C-log.md
# read_C — pp. 42–44, plus p. 45 l.1 (leaves n43–n46), established from the images

Line counts: p. 42 has five lines (a leaf back, so no ornament). p. 43 has five lines (a leaf front, opens ༄༅༔ ༔). p. 44 has five lines. Only the first line of p. 45 (a leaf front, opens ༄༅༔ ༔) is given. That makes 16 print lines.
The witness's line breaks match the print on every line read (16 of 16).

**End of the part.** p. 44 l.5 ends mid-word: …ཁྱོད་རང་དང་དབྱེར | ༄༅༔ ༔མེད་དུ་ཐིམ་ནས་སངས་རྒྱས་པར་འགྱུར་རོ༔. The part ends at **45.1 …སངས་རྒྱས་པར་འགྱུར་རོ༔**, which is the first ༔ on p. 45. The rest of that line, རང་གི་རིག་པའི་རང་མདངས་སུ་མ་ཤེས་ན་ནི༔ བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་རིན་ཆེན་, begins the next part. It is transcribed in full, as asked.
Ending inside p. 44 is possible: its last sentence-closing mark is the ཤིག༔ at the head of 44.5 (…དུང་དུང་གྱིས་ཤིག༔). I don't recommend it. The sentence that follows, "if you recognise [it] as the natural radiance of your own awareness, … you will become a buddha", is the positive half of the pair "recognise → buddhahood / do not recognise → pray to Ratnasambhava". The negative half opens at 45.1 after འགྱུར་རོ༔, so that is the natural seam. (The ༔ after ཤེས་ན་ནི in 44.5 is mid-sentence, after the conditional.)

Method: line bands were located from the frame rules. Each line was cropped in thirds at ×3, and every doubtful syllable at ×6–×12 (LANCZOS, or bicubic/nearest on greyscale).

| 42.2 | འཛིགས → འཇིགས | ×6: the base is ཇ (three prongs, no tsa-phru). The other recension has འཇིགས |
| 42.3 | འོད་ལས་གཉིས → འོད་ལམ་གཉིས | ×5: the second letter is clearly མ. The phrase is "the two light-paths". The other recension has འོད་ལམ་གཉིས |
| 42.4 | བུམ་ཡེངས → བུ་མ་ཡེངས | ×9: a tsheg stands after བུ, and མ is its own syllable (the formula རིགས་ཀྱི་བུ་མ་ཡེངས་པར, as in the other recension) |
| 42.4 | (line end) པའི་ → པའི | ×6: the gi-gu of འི runs up to the frame and there is no tsheg. Needs `# fix` |
| 43.2 | ནམ་ཁའི → ནམཁའི | ×6: ན, མ, ཁ run together with no tsheg and only one མ. This is the same contraction as 34.2 in part 003. Needs `# fix` |
| 43.3 | འོང་ངོ་༔ → འོང་ངོ༔ | ×7: there is nothing between ངོ and ༔ |
| 43.5 | བཟུད་པ → བཟོད་པ | ×7: the na-ro over ཟ is clear and there is no zhabs-kyu. Compare བཟོད in 43.4 |
| 43.5 | (line end) འོང་ངོ་༔ → འོང་ངོ༔ | ×6: there is no tsheg before ༔ |
| 44.1 | འོང་ངོ་༔ → འོང་ངོ༔ | ×8: ༔ follows ངོ directly. Compare 43.2, where the tsheg dot before ༔ is plainly visible (×10) and is kept |
| 44.2 | བཀྲང་མདངས → བཀྲག་མདངས | ×7: the final letter is ག. The phrase is "bright and radiant" (as in the other recension) |
| 44.2 | འོང་གྱིས༔ → འོང་གིས༔ | ×7: there is a gi-gu but no ya-btags under ག. Compare 44.3 འོང་གིས in the witness itself |
| 44.3 | དེ་ཙན་ཁྱོད → དེ་ཙ་ན་ཁྱོད | ×7: a tsheg is visible after ཙ, and ན is its own syllable (the print's own form at 35.2 is དེ་ཙ་ན) |
| 44.3 | དེ་ལམ་འཇིགས → དེ་ལ[?]་མ་འཇིགས | see [?] below |
| 44.4 | བཞུགས་ཤིག → བཞོགས་ཤིག | ×6: a clear na-ro over ཞ and no zhabs-kyu. See the misprints section |
| 44.5 | མཁྱས → མ་བྱས | ×6: the stack is བ with ya-btags (closed box), not ཁ. The phrase is "even without having done devotion" (as in the other recension, མོས་གུས་མ་བྱས) |
| 44.5 | (line end) དབྱེར་ → དབྱེར | ×7: ར ends a few px before the frame and no dot is there. Needs `# fix` for the join with 45.1 |

Witness readings checked and confirmed, though they look odd: 42.1 མངོན་བར (closed བ); 42.2 ཟེར་གྱི (the stack can't be told apart at ×8, so the witness and the other recension are taken); 42.4 འབྱུང་བས་ཐམས (no tsheg between བ and ས, see misprints); 43.1 ཕྱག་ན་ནོར་བུ (two ན at ×8); 43.1 མཱ་མ་ཀི (a-chung under the first མ); 43.2 སེམས་མ་མཱ་ལྱམ (ལ with ya-btags, then མ with no tsheg) and དྷུ་པེ་མ (no a-chung); 43.2 འོང་ངོ་༔ (tsheg present); 43.3 སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱིས་སྐུ (a separate ས after ཀྱི, ×6); 43.3 དག་བ༔ (closed བ, ×8); 43.4 གཅིག༔ (no tsheg, ×8); 43.4/44.3 མཚེར་བ; 44.4 ཤེས་བར (closed བ, ×12); 44.4 གློད་ལ.

## [?] (1)

- 44.3 དེ་ལ[?]་མ་འཇིགས་པར: the letters ལ, མ, འཇ are certain. No tsheg can be seen between ལ and མ, or between མ and འ (×10, both greyscale and binarised), although the tsheg after པ two syllables earlier is visible in the same crop. The witness has ལམ་འཇིགས, which is no word. The sense ("do not be afraid of it") and the other recension (དེ་ལ་མ་འཇིགས་པར) require ལ་མ. I take ལ་མ་ and mark it [?], because the tshegs are probably worn rather than absent.

Close calls not marked [?]:
- 42.5 (line end) སྐུ་: a row of filler dots follows. The first dot can't be told apart from a tsheg, so the witness's tsheg is kept (the read_A rule; fillers left out).
- 43.2 (line end) གཉིས་: a small dot sits right against the frame, at headline height (×9). Taken as a tsheg, as in the witness.
- 45.1 (line end) ཆེན་: a notch where the letter meets the frame, perhaps a tsheg. The witness's tsheg is kept. This lies after the part end.

## Fixes needed (`# fix:` lines)

```
# fix: དག་པའིའོད => དག་པའི་འོད
# fix: ནམཁའི => ནམ་མཁའི
# fix: དང་དབྱེར༄༅༔ ༔མེད => དང་དབྱེར་༄༅༔ ༔མེད
```
- 42.4→42.5: there is no tsheg after པའི at the line end (the next line starts with འོད).
- 43.2 ནམཁའི: a contraction (as 34.2 / 20.5).
- 44.5→45.1: there is no tsheg after དབྱེར at the line end. The next page opens with the ornament, then མེད. The word དབྱེར་མེད runs across the page break. Write the fix in whatever form build.py joins a page-opening ornament (if the ornament is stripped from the joined text: `# fix: དབྱེརམེད => དབྱེར་མེད`).

No line-end abbreviations (པའཾ, ལཾ, subscript-ས) occur on these pages.

## Suspected misprints (kept as printed)

1. 42.4 ཞག་གསུམ་པ་ལ་འབྱུང་བས་ཐམས་ཅད་རྣམ་པར་དག་པའི་འོད་སེར་པོ, which should be འབྱུང་བ་ས་ཐམས་ཅད. Certainty is high on sense. The third day's light is the purified element earth (ས). The print's own parallel for day two reads འབྱུང་བ་ཆུ་ཐམས་ཅད་རྣམ་པར་དག་པའི (dzogchengonpa witness), and the other recension has འབྱུང་བ་ས་རྣམ་པར་དག་པའི. On the image there is no tsheg between བ and ས (×7; the tshegs on either side are visible), so བས is printed. It is a missing tsheg, possibly a worn one. Proposed: `# fix: འབྱུང་བས་ཐམས => འབྱུང་བ་ས་ཐམས`.
2. 43.3 སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱིས་སྐུ་དྲུག, probably meant as ཀྱི ("six buddha forms"). An instrumental makes no sense before སྐུ, and the other recension has ཀྱི. Certainty is moderate: it is the same kind of slip as 35.1 ལས་ངན་གྱིས་དབང. Possible `# fix: རྒྱས་ཀྱིས་སྐུ => རྒྱས་ཀྱི་སྐུ`. This one is the drafter's choice.
3. 44.4 གློད་ལ་བཞོགས་ཤིག: the letters are certain (na-ro). The sense is clear ("relax and rest"; the other recension has ལྷོད་ལ་ཞོག་ཅིག). བཞོགས looks like a mix of བཞག and ཞོག, but it cannot be corrected in only one way. Kept, note only.
4. 43.2 སེམས་མ་མཱ་ལྱམ་དང་དྷུ་པེ་མ: these are the print's transliterations of the goddess names (the other recension has མཱ་ལེ་མ). Not a misprint. Note only.

Not misprints, the print's own spelling: བ for པ (42.1 མངོན་བར, 43.3 དག་བ, 44.4 ཤེས་བར); མཚེར་བ for འཚེར་བ (43.4, 44.3; cf. 34.4); བལྟ for ལྟ (43.4, 43.5); གཅིག for ཞིག (43.4, 44.1).

## Where the other recension differs in sense (print followed)

- 42.3: print འོད་ལམ་གཉིས་བསུ་བ་ལ་འོངས་ཏེ; other recension …གཉིས་ཀྱིས་བསུ་བ་ལ་འོང་སྟེ. The print has no instrumental. Same sense.
- 42.4: print འབྱུང་བས་ཐམས་ཅད (see misprint 1); other recension འབྱུང་བ་ས་རྣམ་པར་དག་པའི, without ཐམས་ཅད.
- 43.1: print བཞུགས་པ༔ ཡུམ…; other recension བཞུགས་ནས་ཡུམ…. Same sense.
- 43.3: print འཇའ་དང་འོད་ཀྱི་ཀློང; other recension འཇའ་དང་འོད་དང་ཟེར་དང་འོད་ཀྱི་ཀློང. The print has no "rays".
- 43.4: print …སེར་ལ་མཚེར་བ་ཐིག་ལེ…; other recension …སེར་ལ་འཚེར་པ༔ ཐིག་ལེ…. Same sense.
- 44.1: print མིའི་འོད་སྔོན་པོ ("blue light of humans"); other recension མིའི་འོད་སྔོན་སེར ("bluish-yellow"). The colour differs. The print is consistent (44.2 སྔོན་པོ too).
- 44.2: print བྲོས་སུ་འོང་གིས༔; other recension བྲོས་སུ་འོང་ཞིང་༔. Close in sense.
- 44.3: print དེ་ཙ་ན; other recension དེ་ཙམ་ན. Same.
- 44.3: print འོད་སེར་པོ་སེར་ལ་མཚེར་བ་གསལ་ལ་དྭངས་པ་དེ་ལ; other recension འོད་སེར་པོ་གསལ་ལ་དྭངས་བ༔ བཀྲག་ལ་དྭངས་བ་དེ་ལ. The epithets differ.
- 44.4: print དེའི་ངང་ལ་…ངང་ལ་གློད་ལ་བཞོགས་ཤིག; other recension དེའི་ཐོག་ཏུ་…ངང་དུ་ལྷོད་ལ་ཞོག་ཅིག. Same sense.
- 44.5–45.1: the same as the print (མོས་གུས་མ་བྱས་སྨོན་ལམ་མ་བཏབ་ཀྱང… དབྱེར་མེད་དུ་ཐིམ་ནས་སངས་རྒྱས་པར་འགྱུར་རོ).
